Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred the country of origin based solely on the father's political title ("Western Roman Emperor") rather than historical fact. While Anthemius was indeed the Western Roman Emperor, his actual birthplace was Constantinople (modern-day Istanbul, Turkey), which was part of the Eastern Roman Empire at the time. The Western Roman Empire was centered in Italy, but Anthemius was a Greek-speaking Roman from the East who was installed as emperor in the West. The Planner failed to verify the specific biographical details regarding Anthemius's birthplace before concluding he was from Italy, leading to a factually incorrect answer.
